scope_statement: Add deterministic execution feedback linking from explicit lane/progress/evidence references into privacy-safe workflow feedback summaries without dispatching lanes, mutating .idiom runtime state, or promoting ranker learning.

commands: idiom tool context_pack --input {"task":"phase 5 execution feedback loop link lane events product evidence release evidence workflow state PRD ADR TDD obligations","mode":"plan","limit":12}
idiom tool context_query --input {"query":"lane events product evidence release evidence workflow state TDD obligations execution feedback linking product workflow","resolution":"symbol"}

go run ./cmd/idiom product feedback --effort-root <temp effort> --lane-history-file references/lane_history.json --plan-progress-file references/plan_progress.json --verification-file references/verification.json --product-evidence-id pe-1 --product-evidence-path product_evidence/export-1.json --release-evidence-id re-1 --release-evidence-path release_evidence/bundle-1.json --brief-path briefs/test.md --changed-path internal/surfaces/cli/product/product_workflow.go --tdd-obligation-ref TDD-IMPL-0029-001 --json
JSON validation for durable workflow artifacts
JSONL validation for durable workflow artifacts
privacy secret-pattern scan over durable effort artifacts

discovery_evidence: context_query:lane events product evidence release evidence workflow state TDD obligations execution feedback linking product workflow
